scope: Theorem 6.1 (Two-substitution comparison) of the manuscript “Algebraic Kuga–Satake correspondences and Hodge conjectures on a K3 quadratic locus” (preprints/Algebraic-Kuga-Satake-correspondences-and-Hodge-conjectures-on-a-K3-quadratic-locus-September-30-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 032 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c9fde2b758f25505), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 39. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let O ⊂ A1 t be a nonempty Zariski open set, and let f : S −→ O, g : X −→ O be smooth projective families of connected surfaces, with the fibers of f K3 surfaces. Suppose that the following conditions hold. (i) A polarized rational subvariation U ⊂ R2f∗Q of K3 type, with nondegenerate restricted cup product, is given. Its period map is nonconstant, and Ut = Ut is simple for all but countably many t ∈ O. (ii) There are commuting involutions j, δ of X over O such that e = 1 4(1 + j)(1 − δ) annihilates Rqg∗Q for q ̸= 2, together with an isomorphism of rational variations of Hodge structure φ : U ∼ − → eR2 g∗Q. (iii) For s in a nonempty Zariski open subset of A1, the total spaces of the two surface families pulled back by t = s + u2 have smooth projective uniruled threefold models. Then there are a nonempty Zariski open set G ⊂ O and a countable set E ⊂ G such that, for every b ∈ G \ E, a correspondence Θb ∈ CH2 (Sb × Xb)Q induces φb on Ub. The open set G and all auxiliary correspondences used before the choice of b can be fixed for the given pencil.
